facts.fact: 章首日记：雷暴夹雪，线路全断，走者来了——与 ch22 Arthur 末条日记同文
facts.anchor: Thunderstorm and snow last night. Looked out of the window, and saw the sky walk by on stilts of lightning. The lines are all down. The walkers are here. I think I might—

facts.fact: 掉落的绝缘子像一条断裂的项链
facts.anchor: the insulators on the ground like a broken necklace

facts.fact: 他恐惧地自语：巨人自由了——Rombold 与 Wade
facts.anchor: The giants are free, he told himself with a surge of horror.

facts.fact: Lucy 端着一只写着「World's Best Dad」的马克杯
facts.anchor: She was holding a mug of tea, with World’s Best Dad written on it in childish letters.

facts.fact: Lucy 的反问：你就在 Arthur 的家里，读他的信、穿他的衣服——而这个（他的日记）是你的？
facts.anchor: And yet, here you are in Arthur’s house. Reading his letters. Wearing his clothes. And what’s this?
‘And yet, here it is,’ said Lucy. ‘Look. Even the handwriting’s the same.’

facts.fact: 窗外成百上千走者：网球色大衣，像等着被喂的动物
facts.anchor: Dark coats, colourful coats, luminous tennis-ball-coloured coats; they stood, without moving, watching the house, like animals waiting to be fed.

facts.fact: 她在最长的夜讲最长的夜的故事：亡者冰冷饥饿地升起
facts.anchor: ‘Let me tell you a story,’ she said. ‘This is, after all, the longest night. The night when spirits walk, and the dead rise cold and hungry from their howes.

facts.fact: 故事开端：从前有一个人，我们就叫他 Arthur Sanderson
facts.anchor: There once was a man. A clever man. We’ll call him Arthur Sanderson.

facts.fact: 他与 Benn 博士（学者兼魔术师）合谋逃脱命运：蒙蔽上帝之眼
facts.anchor: Along with his good friend, Dr Benn, a scholar and a magician, he thought up a plan to escape his fate. To blind, as it were, the Eye of God.

facts.fact: 献祭：他交出记忆、交出对罪行的悔恨，忘了一切逃到荒原
facts.anchor: And so Arthur gave up his memory – the memory of the life he had led, the woman he had loved, their sorrows, their joys, the children they raised together. He even gave up his remorse for the terrible act he’d committed.

facts.fact: 死亡有许多面目：乌鸦之眼、狐狸鹿鼬椋鸟之眼、风暴之眼、闪电之声
facts.anchor: But Death has many guises, many servants, many slaves. She watches from the eye of a crow flying over the snowfields.

facts.fact: 死亡从「古老的直路」观看——地下的路线
facts.anchor: the routes over and under the earth that we sometimes call the Old, Straight Track.

facts.fact: Lucy 反问：你为何如此有归属感、Arthur 的眼镜为何合你、他的爱为何进了你心里
facts.anchor: Did you never wonder why you felt so much at home here? Why Arthur’s glasses suited you? Why Arthur’s love of Caroline found its way into your heart?

facts.fact: 终极揭示：没有 Lyke、没有路、没有山丘、没有水库，只有雪和雾
facts.anchor: ‘There is no turning,’ Lucy said. ‘There’s no such place as Lyke. No road, no hills, no reservoir. Look outside and see for yourself. There’s nothing there but snow and fog.’

facts.fact: 终极揭示之二：所有异常都是他的潜意识在警告自己
facts.anchor: ‘Arthur, this was all you. Your subconscious mind was always trying to find different ways to contact you. To warn you of the danger.

facts.fact: 抉择：嚎叫人被狼群撕碎，还是世界树上的绞神；荒原，还是恐惧之桥
facts.anchor: Which will it be? The Howling Man, torn apart by the wolf pack, or the Hanged God on the World Tree? The whinny-moor or the bridge of dread?

facts.fact: Lucy 最后一句：但要知道，她始终相信你
facts.anchor: ‘But know she always believed in you.’

facts.fact: 全书最后一句：他想我要躺一会儿了——与 Arthur 末条日记一字不差
facts.anchor: He picked up his diary and wrote: I think I’m going to lie down for a while.
